title: PSEB Portal
tagline: Beyond registration: connecting Pakistan’s IT ecosystem.
summary: Rethinking the design of the existing platform to improve their regulatory processes, and designing multi-role platform combining integrated registration, licensing, business collaboration, offerings, opportunities, and learning.
contribution:
Designed the experience understanding the need for PSEB authorities to give off a certain official format. This combined with modern UI and imagery to attract the average user and company employer. I proposed the aim to build an industry community by allowing better access to contact other entities on the platform while improving administrative workflows. The average IT user would benefit from subscribing to services and mentoring by more seasoned individuals on the platform, also allowing them to use a trusted platform to showcase their progress and certifications.
The end result was a platform that was cohesive in design, followed a hierarchy in which information was provided to its user. The platform easily flows from one screen to the next without overwhelming the user with an immediate fully open dashboard.
highlights: Registration flow visibility, differentiated role permissions, opportunity discovery, products and services, webinars and messaging.
